event.description:
Time: 10am registration opens, 11am start round 1
Format: BO3 Swiss with Top Cut (depends on number of participants)
Entry Fee: RM 50

PRIZES

Champion:
4 RDO Booster Packs
7 RDO Event Packs
1x Seraphic Legion's Descent Champion Playmat
1x Nullifying Mirror Nationals Qualifier Card

2nd:
4 RDO Booster Packs + 6 RDO Event Packs

3rd & 4th:
3 RDO Booster Packs + 5 RDO Event Packs
5th to 8th:
2 RDO Booster Packs + 3 RDO Event Packs

9th onwards:
1 RDO Booster Packs + 21 RDO Event Packs

Top 32:
Disintegrate Promo

Consolation Prize for those above 32:
1 PTM Pack 1 + 2 PTM Event Pack

Lucky Draw: TBA on the day of event

Registration is limited to 42 players maximum. Please register through google form here: https://forms.gle/673Dvb7C2aXuZQxc7
